notes.title: Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉
notes.content:
[h3]Get your survival skills ready - Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]Hello Rangers! 

We are happy to announce that our new game [b]Frost Survival VR [/b]has just launched on Steam! 

Frost Survival VR is a sandbox survival set in a frozen wilderness. Face a frozen wilderness solo or in co-op - build a shelter, craft tools, hunt for food, and manage your resources to endure harsh conditions. Strategize your moves against unpredictable weather and lurking dangers. And remember to keep yourself safe and sane![/p][p][/p][h3]Play the game now![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054950/Frost_Survival_VR/"][/dynamiclink]We encourage you to join our community on [url="https://discord.gg/wenklystudio"]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wenklystudio"]TikTok[/url], X and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/FrostSurvivalVR/"]Reddit[/url].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Needs & Survival 🏹[/b][/h3][p]Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wits and limited resources to survive harsh conditions in this [b]Sandbox Survival. [/b]Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?[/p][p][b]Build your Base[/b]: Build a shelter to escape the frost and replenish vital strengths.[/p][p][b]Tools & Weapons[/b]: To survive and fully exploit your surroundings, you will need a variety of tools.[/p][p][b]Hunt, Craft & Gather[/b]: Hunt wild animals to gain food and resources.
[/p][h3][b]Winter & Wilderness❄️[/b][/h3][p]Surviving isn't easy. Strategizing your moves is crucial to staying alive. Complete essential tasks during daylight and be aware of the darkness, as nighttime brings [b]lower temperatures[/b]. [b]Weather conditions[/b] are unpredictable and change dynamically, so always be prepared!  Explore a [b]huge map[/b], but remember that not every place is safe; some may be inaccessible based on your current gear.
[/p][h3][b]Safe & Sane 👾[/b][/h3][p]Survival isn’t just about staying alive; it’s also about [b]staying sane[/b]. How do you keep your humanity in this frozen hell?[/p][p]In Frost Survival VR, you must take care of not only your physiological needs, such as hunger, thirst, and keeping yourself warm, but also your [b]mental health[/b]. If you neglect it, reality may start to blur with illusion. [b]Fake sounds[/b] and [b]creatures[/b] will make survival even more challenging. But beware - some figments of your imagination can harm you!
[/p][h3][b]Multiplayer Experience👥[/b][/h3][p]Try to survive [b]alone[/b] or [b]cooperate[/b] with others in a multiplayer experience.[/p][p]Do you like playing alone? Don’t worry, there are some uncovered secrets scattered across the frozen wilderness that will help you endure. Or you can work together with other players: gather resources, insulate your shelter, and defend against threats like cold, hunger, and dangerous animals. [b]Shape your survival sandbox experience your way![/b][/p][p][img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/shared/images/responsive/youtube_16x9_placeholder.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Private Property is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]Exciting News! Private Property is Now Available! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42268298/f271eebeba5813c2611a3da8e8297371fe66e1fc.png[/img]
Attention all VR gaming enthusiasts! The wait is over, and we are thrilled to announce that[b] Private Property[/b], a long-anticipated VR zombie shooter, is finally here! 

💥Prepare yourself to defend the property from zombies who want to destroy everything around them without mercy! Do not wait any longer! Grab your copy and immerse yourself in the Wild West world of XIX-century Montana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42268298/5b48731ac2c4abe6fe813b777cc329c1b88094b7.jpg[/img]
💥With breathtaking locations, a wide range of weapons such as Bow, Dual Revolvers, Shotgun, Rifle, and Grenade Launcher, and the full body representation with the possibility to customize your appearance, Private Property offers a truly immersive and thrilling VR gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42268298/3ebf80a1d5f8e1fa672a985ee604c3375a3c8873.jpg[/img]
💥We invite you to join our community on Discord and Facebook to connect with fellow gamers, share your thoughts, and stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates. It's the perfect opportunity to exchange tips and engage in thrilling discussions about Private Property.

💻 Join our:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/privatepropertyvr/]Official Facebook Group[/url]
